product.guide_step_1_title: Define the need and preferred unit
product.guide_step_1_body: Confirm the area, product type, budget range, and purchase goal so the advisory team can send the right inventory shortlist.
product.guide_step_2_body: The sales team sends pricing, payment policy, launch incentives, and available inventory so the buyer can compare quickly.
product.guide_step_3_body: Once a suitable product is selected, the buyer can schedule a model-home visit, site tour, or a direct meeting with the sales team.
product.guide_step_4_body: The sales team guides the buyer through reservation, deposit, contract signing, and transaction milestones.
product.guide_note_1: Confirm the product type, floor, orientation, area, and applicable policy before placing a reservation.
product.guide_note_2: If financing is needed, align the payment scenario early so the advisory team can suggest the right plan.
product.guide_note_3: If you need a model-home visit or site appointment, leave a clear note so the sales team can prioritize scheduling.
